about: player.streamInfo.url read from a real jellyfin-web 10.11.11 player (stock web client served by a portable Jellyfin 10.11.11 on loopback, Google Chrome 150 headless) after it direct-played a movie. The player built the URL itself; the capture replaced the ApiKey value with <tok>. The run did not keep the PlaybackInfo response, so mediaSource below lists the fields the URL is built from as they appear in it: this capture pins the URL's shape (path, casing, parameter names and their order, with a real device id), not the lower-casing of Container.
